name: Jason Law
evidence: Two queries anchored on the paper and the employer: '"The ethical imperative of algorithmic fairness in AI-enabled hiring" Law corresponding author email' and '"Jason Law" "WellPass Group" Calgary contact email'. The paper is confirmed as his: AI and Ethics, doi 10.1007/s43681-025-00927-x, link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s43681-025-00927-x, with Jason Law as corresponding author. curl to link.springer.com returned 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' (egress-blocked), so the correspondence block could not be read, and no snippet in the search results printed the address. The only WellPass leads were RocketReach pages giving a company email FORMAT ([first_initial][last]@wellpassgroup.com) — a template, explicitly disallowed — and a masked aggregator record. Nothing verbatim; not found.
